additional_info.subject: Update 23.08
additional_info.body: Hi, please see attachments. Charger goes direclty to authentication fail when credit card is pressed. I attached some logs what i see, no error flags…Also a video sent from costumer. A reboot always fixes the issue but it comes back after 30-60min of operation. This issue suddenly happend around 16.08

additional_info.subject: Case Creation Notes
additional_info.body:
issue seems to be that the terminal doesn’t always “wake up” when costumers press on the charger screen to pay with credit card.
Whenever someone press creditcard on the screen apparently quite often the terminal doesn’t respond and they get a failed message on the screen.
I have sent an email to
jyri.kamarainen@seitatech.fi
at seitatech as well.
According to the costumer this issue happens now everyday and its solved every time with a reboot, but after some operational time terminal starts so fail again and reboot is needed, error present since 16.08
Problem for me is that I don’t see any error from charger side. I only see this in the logs sometimes:
Partial reversal returned with {"status":"error","message":"payment_not_found","details":"payment_not_found"}
AND
[UPT1000F_Castles_SEITATECH]: Command Get terminal status finished with error: Transaction pending.[39m
